name: Bartholomew
title: The Blind Beggar Who Regained His Sight
summary: Bartholomew was a blind beggar who sat by the road outside Jericho and cried out to Jesus for mercy. His unwavering faith led Jesus to heal him and restore his sight. He is a prominent example of the power of faith and perseverance in the Gospels.

keyEvents.title: Bartholomew Sits Begging by the Road
keyEvents.description: Bartholomew, son of Timaeus, sat blind by the roadside outside Jericho begging when Jesus and his disciples passed by.

keyEvents.title: Bartholomew Calls Out to Jesus
keyEvents.description: When Bartholomew heard that it was Jesus from Nazareth passing by, he began to cry out loudly: "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!" His use of the title "Son of David" shows his faith in Jesus as the Messiah.

keyEvents.title: The Crowd Tries to Silence Him
keyEvents.description: Many tried to get Bartholomew to be quiet, but he only cried out even louder and refused to give up. His perseverance in faith is an example for all believers.

keyEvents.title: Jesus Stops and Calls for Him
keyEvents.description: Jesus stopped and asked that the blind man be brought to him. Bartholomew threw off his cloak and ran to Jesus. Jesus asked him: "What do you want me to do for you?"

keyEvents.title: Bartholomew Healed by Faith
keyEvents.description: Bartholomew answered that he would be able to see again. Jesus said to him: "Go your way, your faith has saved you." Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the road.

keyEvents.title: Parallel accounts in the other Gospels
keyEvents.description: The healing of the blind man at Jericho is also recorded in Matthew, where two blind men are mentioned, and in Luke, which emphasizes the people's praise of God after the miracle.
